h1: Land Rover Timing Chain Failure Repair
lede: Professional assessment, strip-down, and repair for failed timing chains on all Land Rover models. Fixed-price quotes after inspection.

blocks.html: When a timing chain fails, it demands a professional, methodical response. At Land Rover Garage, we handle the entire journey from initial assessment through to complete repair. Our process includes:

items: Full diagnostic scan and acoustic inspection to confirm chain failure
Strip-down inspection (front- or rear-mounted chain access) to assess damage
Replacement of timing chain(s), tensioners, guides, and any affected sprockets
Precise timing set using manufacturer locking tools
Comprehensive testing and road test before handover

blocks.html: Every repair is backed by our [12-month unlimited-mileage warranty](/warranty).

Our timing chain failure repair covers all Land Rover models that use timing-chain-driven engines. Below are the most common applications we see in our workshop.

blocks.note: TD5, 200Tdi, 300Tdi, and modern Ingenium diesels (D200/D250/D300) — timing chain and tensioner wear is a known pattern.
TDV6/SDV6 (D3/D4) and Ingenium diesels (D5) — timing chain tensioner failure is a widely documented issue.
TDV6/SDV6 (L322/L405) and V8 diesel/petrol — chain and guide wear affects many vehicles in this range.
TDV6/SDV6 and supercharged V8 (SVR) — timing chain issues are common across the Sport lineage.
Ingenium diesel and petrol (D180/D200/D240/D250, P250/P300) — timing chain tensioner wear is a known pattern.
Ingenium diesel (D150/D165/D180/D200) — timing chain wear is a frequent concern.
Ingenium diesel (D150/D165/D180) and petrol — timing chain issues affect both fuel types.
M47D20 (Td4) and Ford Duratorq — timing chain stretch is a known pattern.

blocks.html: If your model isn't listed, [contact us](/contact) — we cover the entire Land Rover range.

steps.title: Initial Assessment
steps.body: We receive your vehicle, record details, and perform a diagnostic scan and acoustic inspection to confirm timing chain failure.

steps.title: Strip-down Inspection
steps.body: Access is gained (front or rear, depending on engine) to visually inspect chains, tensioners, guides, and sprockets. Oil system checked for debris.

steps.title: Damage Assessment & Quotation
steps.body: All damaged components are documented and photographed. We provide a fixed-price quotation for the repair or rebuild.

steps.title: Component Replacement
steps.body: New timing chain kit (chains, tensioners, guides, sprockets) is installed. All gaskets and seals are renewed.

steps.title: Timing Set & Reassembly
steps.body: Timing is set to manufacturer specification using locking tools. Front-end components (or subframe/gearbox) are reassembled.

steps.title: Testing & Validation
steps.body: Engine is started, run to temperature, and timing verified with live data. A road test confirms everything is working correctly.

items.q: What happens during a timing chain failure repair?
items.a: We carry out a full assessment, strip-down to access the timing chain, replace all worn components (chains, tensioners, guides, sprockets), set timing precisely, and test the engine thoroughly. The exact procedure depends on whether the chain is front- or rear-mounted.

items.q: How long does a timing chain repair take?
items.a: Assessment typically takes 1-2 days. The repair itself can take 1-3 weeks, depending on parts availability and whether additional damage (e.g., bent valves) is found. We will give you a clear timeframe before work starts.

items.q: Do you offer a warranty on timing chain repairs?
items.a: Yes — every repair comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty covering parts and labour.

items.q: What if the engine is beyond repair?
items.a: If the engine is irreparable, we will advise on the best course of action, which may include replacement with a fully tested unit. We only proceed with your approval.
Yes — we offer nationwide recovery from £70. Most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.
